headline: TenTrade Considers Nigerian Expansion and Unveils Referral Rebates
summary: TenTrade is considering a Nigerian office expansion, offering referral rebates of up to $10 per lot, and launching a 20 percent discount on funded accounts.
why: TenTrade operates as an online trading platform and broker, competing for retail trader acquisition in emerging markets.

impacts.name: TenTrade
impacts.why: Brokerage expansion initiatives target regional client acquisition and fee-based revenue growth.
